name: summarizer
description: Regression suite for a long-document summarisation prompt.

defaults.system: You are a precise summarisation assistant. Never invent facts.

fixtures.title: Produces exactly three bullets
fixtures.prompt:
Summarise the following release note in exactly three bullet points:

{{releaseNote}}

variables.releaseNote: Version 2.1 adds offline sync, fixes a crash on export and improves startup time by 30%.

fixtures.frozenOutput:
- Offline sync is now supported.
- Export no longer crashes on large files.
- Startup time improved by 30%.

assertions.name: mentions every key point of the note
expected: mentions offline sync, the export crash fix and the startup improvement
lists offline sync, a fix for the export crash and a 30% faster startup

fixtures.title: Returns a JSON object with a headline and bullets
fixtures.prompt: Return a JSON object with a "headline" string and a "bullets" array of strings.

fixtures.title: Refuses to answer when the source is missing
fixtures.prompt: Summarise the quarterly report that was never attached.
fixtures.frozenOutput: I don't have the quarterly report. Please attach the document and I will summarise it.

assertions.name: asks for the missing document
assertions.expected: Q3 revenue grew 12% to 4.2M and churn fell to 1.8%.
